description.zh: 指定修改后的用户组备注信息。最多支持500字符。
description.en: The new description of the user group. The description can be up to 500 characters in length.

description.zh:
指定要修改用户公钥的堡垒机的实例id。
>您可以调用[describeinstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to modify the public key of a user.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh:
指定修改后的用户公钥。
> 使用Base64编码。
description.en:
The new public key.

> Specify a Base64-encoded string.

description.zh:
需要修改的用户公钥id。
> 您可以调用[ListUserPublicKeys](~~477555~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the public key that you want to modify.

> You can call the [ListUserPublicKeys](~~477555~~) operation to query the public key ID.

description.zh: 指定要修改的公钥名称。最多支持128字符。
description.en: The name of the public key that you want to modify. This name can be up to 128 characters in length.

description.zh:
指定要修改用户公钥的堡垒机所在的区域id。
>区域id和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host that is used to modify the public key of the user.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-user-public-key --instance-id bastionhost-cn-nif23000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --public-key-id 2 --public-key-name name --public-key c3NoLWVkMjU1MTkgQUFBQUMzTnphQzFsWkRJMU5URTVBQUFBSUhVcjY4UENFYWFzZjFYRVpNYTVsMlNBQytHV3FpeXVsRVpndkV4dmlPM28gcm9vdEA5NjBkMmNhOTcwYjU= --comment comment --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ModifyUserPublicKey --region cn-hangzhou --Comment comment --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-nif23000000' --PublicKey 'c3NoLWVkMjU1MTkgQUFBQUMzTnphQzFsWkRJMU5URTVBQUFBSUhVcjY4UENFYWFzZjFYRVpNYTVsMlNBQytHV3FpeXVsRVpndkV4dmlPM28gcm9vdEA5NjBkMmNhOTcwYjU=' --PublicKeyId 2 --PublicKeyName name --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
